items.title: Gemini's Agentic Video Understanding Cuts Video Tokens by 88%
items.author: developersdigest.tech
items.summary: Google shipped agentic video understanding on Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite: the model decides which frames, audio, and transcripts to inspect instead of swallowing video at a fixed frame rate. Verified numbers: up to 88% fewer tokens, up to 66% lower cost, and up to 7% better accuracy on video benchmarks. ... On September 1, Google launched agentic video understanding across Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite. The feature makes the model decide what to watch in a video instead of ingesting every frame: it scans video segments dynamically across visual frames, audio, and transcripts, using its native video tools to load only the parts relevant to the query.
